gen-dafont-outrun-future-gf-marcellus-sc: Wide-spaced and glowing with synthwave attitude, Outrun Future draws a single-width outline you could trace by finger. Marcellus SC takes over for the text, its gentle stroke modulation and pulled-back terminals giving a classic serif some literary dignity.
gen-dafont-outrun-future-gf-montagu-slab: Outrun Future draws its wide-set letters with an outline as uniform as a length of rope, tall in the x-height and short in the ascenders. Montagu Slab runs on robust downstrokes and slender turns, which keeps a long text serif page comfortable.
gen-dafont-outrun-future-gf-noto-serif-h: Authoritative and a touch synthwave, Outrun Future looks drawn with a ruler and compass, every line the same heft. Noto Serif Hentaigana is the opposite in temperament, its weight shifting gradually through open-jawed curves instead of snapping.
gen-dafont-outrun-future-gf-ovo: Authoritative from the first glance, Outrun Future keeps its tails and terminals as thick as its stems, wide-set and synthwave. Ovo thins only slightly, like letters stamped in soft metal, so the two feel like a neon sign hung in an old study.
gen-dafont-ozone-fs-asap: Ozone's strokes never vary, with no thick or thin anywhere in its geometric forms. Asap brings a body height nearly matching the capitals and open-arc c shapes, and that readable steadiness is what the pair does best.
gen-dafont-ozone-fs-epilogue: Ozone barely distinguishes capitals from lowercase, and its round forms end in wide-set curves with one thickness throughout. Epilogue follows with curvy, wire-like monoline letters and stubby ascender tips, so give it a little more size than usual.
gen-dafont-ozone-fs-fira-sans: Technical in temperament, Ozone sets stems and crossbars at one thickness, with capitals barely taller than its lowercase. Fira Sans carries a long page easily, its large x-height and wide-mouthed s curves making a plain sans feel open from line to line.
gen-dafont-ozone-general-sans: General Sans fills the line with a tall x-height and steady pen pressure, so every bend glides through without a snag. Ozone, by contrast, earns its place in display, geometric and technical, while this plain sans handles the reading.
gen-dafont-ozone-gf-fauna-one: Literary and dignified, this body has a tall middle band, shallow ascenders and a generous entry into the e. Ozone, though, is the one to enlarge in a short line, where its stylus-width strokes and wide round forms can stand out.
gen-dafont-ozone-gf-glegoo: Editorial in mood, Glegoo has big counters and wide, unclosed mouths on a tall lowercase. Ozone, with its single-width pen line and geometric curves, can go larger in the heading while this classic serif stays at a comfortable text size.
